mechanism: Both agents prolong QT interval through different mechanisms (moxifloxacin via potassium channel blockade, erythromycin via CYP3A4 inhibition and direct cardiac effects), creating additive risk of torsades de pointes.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if essential, obtain baseline ECG, monitor QTc interval closely, and correct electrolyte abnormalities (K+, Mg2+) before and during therapy.
